name: Volume Raycasting with Surface Extraction and Phong Shading
definition: A volume rendering technique that extracts surfaces from a 3D volume using a threshold and renders them using raycasting with Phong illumination, operating on multiple object volumes simultaneously.
summary: This method renders 3D volume data by extracting surfaces via scalar thresholds and applying Phong shading, differing from standard volume rendering by accumulating color only at the first voxel exceeding the threshold.
